data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Karos' meaning 'dear' and 'Lee' meaning 'lion'. The name Karleen symbolizes a strong, pure, and clear-hearted individual. In Christian tradition, it is associated with the purity and strength of the Virgin Mary. The name Karleen carries the meaning “Pure, clear one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karleen usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Karleen belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, clear one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karleen total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Karleen carries a unique blend of Greek and Christian influences. In Greek culture, the name Karos signifies 'dear', emphasizing the significance of love and connections among family and friends. With the addition of 'Lee' meaning 'lion', which represents courage, bravery, and power, Karleen becomes a name that represents a person with a strong and loving character.
data.spiritual_significance: From a Christian perspective, the name Karleen carries the spiritual meaning of purity, strength and devotion. As another variation of the name Mary, which is the most widely used name in Christianity, Karleen is a reminder of the blessings bestowed upon us by Mary, the mother of Jesus. The name Karleen not only signifies the strength and power of the Virgin Mary but also encourages us to embody her virtues of love, devotion, and purity in our daily lives.
